title: Raindrop walk
story: A raindrop walks down to G, hops back to B, and rests by A.
childCue: Play B, A, G, A, B, B, A.
adultCue: This is an original garden tune. Let the child hear it in small pieces before trying the whole path.
successCue: You played the whole raindrop walk!
tips: Try three notes at a time first.
A rest is part of music too.
